images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic square ecommerce hero photograph, a single Bone ivory oversized pullover hoodie, entire garment visible with clear margin on every side, overhead flat lay on a warm ivory matte studio surface. Reference image 1 is mood and texture ONLY: warm upper-left daylight, believable cotton, soft shadows. Reference image 2 is the exact garment silhouette and branding placement guide, NOT a drawing style to copy. Reference image 3 is the authoritative OFF SHFT logo artwork to embroider faithfully. Garment: AS Colour 5161-inspired oversized relaxed fit, dropped shoulders, lined hood with absolutely NO drawcord or eyelets, front kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem. Bone fabric concept colour #E4DDCB. Lay the hoodie front-up, hood open naturally, sleeves gently angled outward and down, cuffs and hem completely inside frame, mild natural fabric folds, very believable cotton surface and seams. One very small OFF SHFT embroidered logo 63 mm wide on the wearer's LEFT chest, which is viewer RIGHT; approximately one tenth of torso width, not large. Ink letters/ring #1F2733, Rust #B4552D hands and central dot. Preserve the exact logo design and the space between OFF and SHFT; no I in SHFT. Clock hand one points straight up to 12, the other diagonally DOWN-RIGHT at 5 o'clock, never straight down at 6. Both hands outside the ring with visible gaps and a rust pivot dot inside it. Subtle thread texture, restrained real-scale embroidery. No props, no packaging, no hangtags, no external captions, no arrows, no circle inset, no watermark, no labels, no mannequin, no body. This is a draft design concept, but do not print that text in the image. Premium believable product photography, no stylized illustration or CGI sheen.
